import os import re import time from pathlib import Path import psutil from memory.capture.foreground_activity import ( get_recent_foreground_activity, ) from memory.capture.common.permissions import is_allowed from memory.capture.file.universal_extractor import get_chunk from memory.capture.file.file_snapshot import create_snapshot from memory.capture.file.file_evidence import create_file_evidence from memory.database.activity_evidence_db import save_activity_evidence SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS = { ".txt", ".md", ".csv", ".json", ".xml", ".yaml", ".yml", ".py", ".js", ".ts", ".html", ".css", ".sql", ".pdf", ".doc", ".docx", ".odt", ".rtf", ".xls", ".xlsx", ".xlsm", ".ods", ".ppt", ".pptx", ".odp", } APP_TITLE_SUFFIXES = ( " - ONLYOFFICE", " - Microsoft Word", " - Word", " - Microsoft Excel", " - Excel", " - Microsoft PowerPoint", " - PowerPoint", " - WPS Office", ) SKIP_DIRS = { "appdata", ".git", "node_modules", ".venv", "venv", "__pycache__", "program files", "windows", } # Cache filename lookups so repeated sessions don't rescan folders. _path_cache = {} def _filename_from_title(title): """Extract a supported filename from a window title.""" title = title.strip() for suffix in APP_TITLE_SUFFIXES: if title.lower().endswith(suffix.lower()): title = title[:-len(suffix)].strip() # Remove common unsaved-document markers. title = title.lstrip("*").strip() pattern = ( r'([^\\/:*?"<>|\r\n]+\.' r'(?:' + "|".join( re.escape(ext.lstrip(".")) for ext in SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS ) + r'))' ) match = re.search(pattern, title, re.IGNORECASE) return match.group(1).strip() if match else None def _path_from_title(title): """Use an absolute path if the application exposes one.""" pattern = ( r'([A-Za-z]:\\.*?\.(?:' + "|".join( re.escape(ext.lstrip(".")) for ext in SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS ) + r'))(?=$|\s+-\s)' ) match = re.search(pattern, title, re.IGNORECASE) if match: candidate = Path(match.group(1)) if candidate.is_file(): return candidate.resolve() return None def _path_from_process(pid, filename): """Try to find the document among files opened by the app.""" if not pid or not filename: return None try: process = psutil.Process(pid) for opened_file in process.open_files(): candidate = Path(opened_file.path) if ( candidate.name.lower() == filename.lower() and candidate.is_file() ): return candidate.resolve() except (psutil.Error, OSError): pass return None def _search_user_folders(filename): """ Search the user's profile for a unique matching filename. Ambiguous matches are deliberately rejected. """ if not filename: return None cache_key = filename.lower() if cache_key in _path_cache: return _path_cache[cache_key] home = Path.home() preferred = [ home / "Downloads", home / "Documents", home / "Desktop", home / "OneDrive", ] matches = set() # Search common folders first. for root in preferred: if not root.is_dir(): continue for directory, subdirs, files in os.walk(root): subdirs[:] = [ d for d in subdirs if d.lower() not in SKIP_DIRS ] for item in files: if item.lower() == cache_key: matches.add( (Path(directory) / item).resolve() ) if len(matches) > 1: break if len(matches) > 1: break # If not found in common folders, search the remaining profile. if not matches: for directory, subdirs, files in os.walk(home): current = Path(directory) if current == home: subdirs[:] = [ d for d in subdirs if d.lower() not in SKIP_DIRS and d not in { "Downloads", "Documents", "Desktop", "OneDrive", } ] else: subdirs[:] = [ d for d in subdirs if d.lower() not in SKIP_DIRS ] for item in files: if item.lower() == cache_key: matches.add( (current / item).resolve() ) if len(matches) > 1: break result = next(iter(matches)) if len(matches) == 1 else None _path_cache[cache_key] = result return result def resolve_document_path(activity): """Resolve a document path without guessing between duplicates.""" title = activity.get("window_title", "") path = _path_from_title(title) if path: return path filename = _filename_from_title(title) if not filename: return None path = _path_from_process( activity.get("process_id"), filename, ) if path: return path return _search_user_folders(filename) def capture_active_document(activity, path): """Extract and save one active-document evidence record.""" if not path.is_file() or not is_allowed(path): return try: result = get_chunk(str(path), chunk_number=0) event = { "source_type": "file", "action": "opened", "path": str(path), "timestamp": time.strftime( "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S", time.localtime(activity["timestamp"]), ), } snapshot = create_snapshot(event, result) evidence = create_file_evidence(snapshot) evidence_id = save_activity_evidence(evidence) print( f"Saved active-document evidence: " f"{path.name} (ID: {evidence_id})" ) except Exception as exc: print( f"Could not capture active document " f"{path.name}: {exc}" ) def monitor_active_documents(): """ Capture documents opened in supported document applications. Skip VS Code because its activity is handled by the VS Code monitor. Uses the shared foreground monitor; starts no new thread. """ previous_key = None attempted_key = None last_attempt = 0.0 print("Active document monitor started.") while True: try: history = get_recent_foreground_activity() activity = history[0] if history else None if not activity: previous_key = None attempted_key = None time.sleep(0.5) continue key = ( activity.get("hwnd"), activity.get("process_id"), activity.get("window_title"), ) # Skip VS Code; its activity is captured by its own monitor. process_name = ( activity.get("process_name") or "" ).lower() if process_name in {"code.exe", "code-insiders.exe"}: previous_key = key attempted_key = key time.sleep(0.5) continue if key != previous_key: previous_key = key attempted_key = None last_attempt = 0.0 title = activity.get("window_title", "") filename = _filename_from_title(title) if ( filename and key != attempted_key and time.time() - last_attempt >= 1.0 ): last_attempt = time.time() path = resolve_document_path(activity) if path: attempted_key = key if is_allowed(path): capture_active_document(activity, path) else: # Avoid repeatedly searching for the same document. attempted_key = key time.sleep(0.5) except Exception as exc: print(f"Active document monitor error: {exc}") time.sleep(1.0) if __name__ == "__main__": monitor_active_documents()

MAR THOMA YUVAJANA SAKHYAM
YOUTH SUNDAY  - 2026
 SERMON NOTES
  1
St. Matt. 7: 21-27
Whenever a builder starts constructing a house, the most important work happens where
no one can see. Before the walls go up, and long before the paint dries, the builder has to dig down
deep into the dirt until they strike solid rock. If they take shortcuts and ignore the foundation, even
the most beautiful house will come crashing down the moment a heavy storm hits.
Today, on this Youth Sunday, we live in a world that focuses almost entirely on the outside.
We are constantly taught to look successful, keep our social media feeds bright, and pretend that
our lives are completely put together. But behind those bright smiles, many of our youth are quietly
struggling. There is the heavy stress of exams, the search for stable jobs, the ache of loneliness
in distant cities and hostels, and the fear of falling behind. In Matthew 7, Jesus does not care about
the paint on our walls. He looks straight through the appearance and asks one vital question: what
is holding your life up from beneath?
1.  Rooted in Christ: Going Beyond the Surface
Jesus warns us that simply saying “Lord, Lord” is never enough. It is easy to come to
church every Sunday, wear nice clothes, sing the songs, and still be building our lives on loose
sand. Sand is comfortable because it requires zero effort. It means living for instant likes, following
the crowd, and treating God like an afterthought.
Building on the rock takes real work. It means choosing to dig past our pride and our selfish
desires. To be rooted in Christ means our worth is not decided by our job title, our salary, or what
people say about us. It means making time every day to pray, read His Word, and anchor our
identity in the love of Jesus. When your roots grip the bedrock of Christ, no trend or hardship can
wash you away.
2. Driven by Faith: Hearing That Becomes Doing
Both builders in the parable heard the exact same words of Jesus. The only difference was
that one walked away and did nothing, while the other went home and put those words into practice.
Real faith is never just sitting quietly in a pew. Faith has hands and feet.
In our Mar Thoma tradition, faith is always meant to be lived out. When we are driven by
faith, our belief changes how we act on Monday morning. It means being honest in an office where
others cheat. It means standing up for a friend who is left out. It means trusting God with your
future even when the doors seem closed. Faith does not keep the rain away, but it gives us the
courage to keep walking through the downpour.
This question remains before us as followers of Christ. Can you join the sorrow of a different
person who is facing neglect? Can you join his dreams? The man’s answer is not a condemnation,
but the sorrow of not having a group that understands him and holds him together. Our mission is
to become that group which understand and hold together.
                 Youth: Rooted in Christ, Driven by Faith, and Living with Purpose

from pathlib import Path import os import threading import time from datetime import datetime from watchdog.observers import Observer from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler from memory.capture.common.activity_event import create_activity_event from memory.capture.common.permissions import ( is_allowed, get_permission_mode ) from memory.capture.common.deduplicator import ActivityDeduplicator from memory.capture.foreground_activity import ( get_recent_foreground_activity, start_foreground_monitor ) from memory.capture.user_interaction_filter import ( is_user_interacting_with_file ) from memory.capture.file.universal_extractor import get_chunk from memory.capture.file.file_snapshot import create_snapshot from memory.capture.file.file_evidence import create_file_evidence from memory.database.activity_evidence_db import save_activity_evidence def is_vscode_file_activity(file_path, foreground_history): """ Return True when the changed file matches the file shown in the active VS Code window. """ filename = Path(file_path).name.casefold() vscode_processes = { "code.exe", "code-insiders.exe", } for activity in foreground_history: process_name = ( activity.get("process_name") or "" ).casefold() if process_name not in vscode_processes: continue window_title = ( activity.get("window_title") or "" ).casefold() if filename and filename in window_title: return True return False class FileActivityHandler(FileSystemEventHandler): def __init__(self): super().__init__() self.deduplicator = ActivityDeduplicator() def process_activity(self, activity, event_timestamp=None): """ Process a filesystem activity event. """ if self.deduplicator.is_duplicate(activity): return # ------------------------------------------------- # Permission check # ------------------------------------------------- if not is_allowed(activity["path"]): print( "Ignoring file outside allowed permissions:", activity["path"] ) return # ------------------------------------------------- # Exact filesystem event timestamp # ------------------------------------------------- if event_timestamp is None: try: event_timestamp = datetime.fromisoformat( activity["timestamp"] ).timestamp() except Exception: event_timestamp = time.time() # ------------------------------------------------- # Foreground activity correlation # ------------------------------------------------- foreground_history = get_recent_foreground_activity() if not is_user_interacting_with_file( activity["path"], foreground_history, event_timestamp ): #print( #"Ignoring background file activity:", #activity["path"] #) return # ------------------------------------------------- # User-driven activity detected # ------------------------------------------------- print("
User-driven file activity detected:") print(activity) # Deleted files cannot be extracted. if activity["action"] == "deleted": return file_path = Path(activity["path"]) if not file_path.exists(): return # ------------------------------------------------- # Extract content # ------------------------------------------------- result = get_chunk( activity["path"], chunk_number=0 ) # ------------------------------------------------- # Create snapshot # ------------------------------------------------- snapshot = create_snapshot( activity, result ) print("Activity Snapshot:") print(snapshot) # ------------------------------------------------- # Create evidence # ------------------------------------------------- evidence = create_file_evidence(snapshot) print("Activity Evidence:") print(evidence) # ------------------------------------------------- # Save evidence # ------------------------------------------------- evidence_id = save_activity_evidence(evidence) print("Saved Evidence ID:", evidence_id) # ===================================================== # CREATED # ===================================================== def on_created(self, event): if event.is_directory: return event_timestamp = time.time() if is_allowed(event.src_path): activity = create_activity_event( source_type="file", action="created", path=event.src_path ) self.process_activity( activity, event_timestamp ) # ===================================================== # MODIFIED # ===================================================== def on_modified(self, event): if event.is_directory: return event_timestamp = time.time() if is_allowed(event.src_path): activity = create_activity_event( source_type="file", action="modified", path=event.src_path ) self.process_activity( activity, event_timestamp ) # ===================================================== # MOVED # ===================================================== def on_moved(self, event): if event.is_directory: return event_timestamp = time.time() if is_allowed(event.dest_path): activity = create_activity_event( source_type="file", action="moved", path=event.dest_path, metadata={ "old_path": event.src_path } ) self.process_activity( activity, event_timestamp ) # ===================================================== # DELETED # ===================================================== def on_deleted(self, event): if event.is_directory: return event_timestamp = time.time() if is_allowed(event.src_path): activity = create_activity_event( source_type="file", action="deleted", path=event.src_path ) self.process_activity( activity, event_timestamp ) # ========================================================= # MONITORING SCOPE # ========================================================= def get_monitoring_folder(): """ Determine the Watchdog monitoring scope. allow_all: C:\Users\<username> allow_only: memory\tests\test_data """ permission_mode = get_permission_mode() if permission_mode == "allow_all": username = os.environ.get("USERNAME", "") if not username: raise RuntimeError( "Could not determine Windows username." ) return Path( os.path.join( r"C:\Users", username ) ).resolve() if permission_mode == "allow_only": return Path( "memory/tests/test_data" ).resolve() raise RuntimeError( f"Unsupported permission mode: {permission_mode}" ) # ========================================================= # START FILE MONITOR # ========================================================= def start_file_monitor(start_foreground=True): """ Start the filesystem monitor. The monitoring scope is determined here. start_foreground=True: Used when running this module directly. start_foreground=False: Used by activity_manager, which already owns the shared foreground monitor. """ folder = get_monitoring_folder() permission_mode = get_permission_mode() if not folder.exists(): raise RuntimeError( f"Monitoring folder does not exist: {folder}" ) event_handler = FileActivityHandler() observer = Observer() observer.schedule( event_handler, str(folder), recursive=True ) # ----------------------------------------------------- # Foreground monitor # ----------------------------------------------------- if start_foreground: foreground_thread = threading.Thread( target=start_foreground_monitor, daemon=True ) foreground_thread.start() print("Foreground activity monitor started.") # ----------------------------------------------------- # Watchdog # ----------------------------------------------------- observer.start() print("
File monitor started.") print(f"Permission mode: {permission_mode}") print(f"Monitoring: {folder}") print("Press Ctrl+C to stop.
") try: while True: time.sleep(1) except KeyboardInterrupt: print("
Stopping file monitor...") observer.stop() observer.join() # ========================================================= # STANDALONE # ========================================================= if __name__ == "__main__": start_file_monitor()
